fact: The document states the third general population and housing census (RGPH-3) was held in 2018.
INSTAT presented the RGPH-4 project document to partners on 12 May 2026, with enumeration planned for 2028, digital cartography and data collection, and WB STATCAP II and UNFPA support.
The document states RGPH-3 was carried out in 2018.

A UN Madagascar account dated 2026-03-05 describes MICS7 2025, carried out by INSTAT with UNICEF, on 21,000 households in 23 regions with 99% response, as a reference data source; no separate release date is given.

INSTAT, with UNICEF support, published results of the MICS-7 2025 national household survey (19,785 households, representative sample, fieldwork late December 2024 to May 2025) on its site; the document gives 28 February 2026 as its date.
